description.value: Enrico Winery is a 100% local, family-owned BC winery set on a working vineyard in Mill Bay, offering drop-in tastings in their tasting room and across two outdoor patios. Dogs are welcome on the outdoor patio and the facilities are confirmed accessible. Wine is available to purchase and take away, and light snack items are available for on-site purchase.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content fully confirms all OSM contact details (address, phone, website) and shows an active, family-owned winery with a tasting room and outdoor patios. The 'Plan Your Visit' FAQ confirms accessible facilities (implying washrooms exist on-site) and that wine and light snacks are available for purchase, but explicitly states outside food and beverages are not permitted. No bike-specific amenities (rack, pump, e-bike charging, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Outside food and beverages are not permitted on the property, which may be a limitation for cyclists carrying their own snacks.
No bike-specific amenities (rack, pump, charging) are mentioned on the website; cyclists should not assume any are available.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active winery with a public tasting room, accessible facilities, dog-friendly outdoor patio, and snacks for purchase — a worthwhile destination stop for touring cyclists in the Mill Bay area.

wow_evidence: 100% local, family-owned BC winery... drop-in tastings... two outdoor patios
